# Cncf Deepflow Reviewer

Review DeepFlow using its official documentation and repository in the AI Native Infra / Observability category. DeepFlow leverages eBPF to collect signals such as performance metrics, distributed tracing, and CPU &amp; GPU profiling. Its goal is to provide zero-code observability for complex cloud-native and AI applications, particularly those involving LLM training and inference using frameworks like PyTorch.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
